data.name: Necropsychic Conduit
data.description: A necrologist can cast psychic spells as if she had the Thanatopic Spell and Threnodic Spell metamagic feats, using her undead phantom as a conduit to pierce the defenses of undead creatures. If her phantom has been banished or is not within 30 feet of her when she casts the spells, however, these feats have no effect.
